name: What factors should I consider when choosing a builder for a rental tiny home?

mainEntity.name: What factors should I consider when choosing a builder for a rental tiny home?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a builder for your rental tiny home, consider their experience with local regulations, particularly for ADUs in areas like Vista, Oceanside, Carlsbad, and San Marcos. Look for a portfolio of successfully completed projects, transparent pricing, and a clear communication process. Verify their licensing and insurance. A reputable builder will provide a detailed contract, manage permits, and offer a warranty. Zen Tiny Homes specializes in custom tiny homes as ADUs, providing comprehensive services from design to completion.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a builder with experience in local ADU regulations, a strong portfolio, transparent pricing, and proper licensing. Zen Tiny Homes offers comprehensive services for rental tiny homes.
